records.label: Dritan Hoxha residential and service development

location.name: Rruga Dritan Hoxha, near Sheshi Rilindja

sources.detail: Decision No. 22 amended the earlier approved project; not a completion record.
Documents the organized construction site and site photographs, and cites original permit 215/17 Prot., 2023-11-03. Record date refers to the decision, not the photo capture date.
Replacement site plan. Technical indicators identify nine cadastral parcels in zone 8310; neither a readable geographic XY table nor a coordinate reference system was verified.

limitations: Construction was documented at the time of the regulatory file; no as-built proof or current progress date was verified.
Do not substitute Sheshi Rilindja’s centre or the street centreline for the development site.
Use cadastral matching for spatial reference; design quantities are not as-built measurements.
